mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 260 indicates persistent high inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate monetary tightening, which negatively impacts equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in the equity market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns in >40% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.0%) indicates a monetary policy response to a severe labor market downturn, which typically leads to a temporary equity market rally as the Fed intervenes, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.0%) fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a zero-interest-rate policy (ZIRP) regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to ultra-low rates supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25.
